description: TD-269: remove the existing Vite production chunk advisory with minimal route/module splitting, preserving Portfolio/Dashboard/Project/Planning/Board behavior and deferring only the measured core route/tab modules required by the unchanged size boundary.
deviation_notes: All 13 explicit Task labels completed (the original estimate was 16; their checked subtasks are also complete). The opening build transformed 2,800 modules and emitted a 1,354.26 kB minified JavaScript chunk (382.84 kB gzip) with Vite's unchanged default over-500 kB advisory; the build itself was the size RED oracle. Route/module lazy splitting removed the advisory without changing the 500 kB threshold or adding manualChunks. Measured rebuilds showed optional-only ~1.12 MB, Project View tabs ~563 kB, Dashboard/index ~545 kB, and Board/Planning ~518 kB; this justified the permitted lazy-core exception, with behavior preserved and the final Project route at 436.04 kB / 135.39 kB gzip. Final frontend unit coverage was 177 files / 1,301 tests in 145.70s with zero warning output; focused route/lazy contracts, check, lint, real Chrome, Doctor, graph synchronization, and documentation gates are recorded in closeout.md. Final graph stats are 5,991 nodes / 8,314 edges / 744 files; audit ran for 90 seconds with no stdout/stderr and was Ctrl-C stopped under known issue #2, reproduced at https://github.com/bodangren/fleet-commander/issues/2#issuecomment-5229868421.
